summary: Backend-only verification of the AI env-key fallback that mirrors a VPS without a DB-saved key. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_ai_env_fallback.py covering all 6 requested scenarios. All 6 tests PASSED in 139s. GET /api/admin/settings/ai returns source='env-key' with provider='gemini', model='gemini-3.8-flash', env_key_present=true, masked_key present. POST /api/admin/settings/ai/test returns ok:true, mode='direct', reply contains 'ok' (confirms direct HTTPS to Google, not Emergent proxy). DOCX import of Hydrocarbons_Questions.docx (Chemistry, extract) completed with status='done', used_ai=true and count>=60 questions — this is the PRIMARY FIX for the VPS. PDF import of Hydrocarbons_Solutions.pdf completed with count>0. DB override via PUT flipped source to 'admin'; DELETE then restored source='env-key'. Login requires role (401/422 without it). Final state confirmed via live curl: source='env-key' (no DB 'ai' doc), mirroring the VPS as required.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_key.resolve_full(): 'emergent' flag computed via key.startswith('sk-emergent-') — a user-supplied admin key happening to start with that prefix would be mis-routed to emergent branch. Minor edge case; prefer tracking source explicitly.

ai_key.load_from_db() clears _cfg.api_key when env-key is used; good. But resolve() returns env-key tuple only when _cfg.api_key is unset — behaviour is correct, just worth a code comment to prevent regressions.
server.py is 3620 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; split admin/settings/ai, import pipeline, and auth into separate routers for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. DB override test cleans up its own doc so preview remains env-key-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI is currently sourced from GEMINI_API_KEY env var only; DB settings.ai doc is intentionally absent so preview mirrors VPS. Any test that saves an admin AI key MUST DELETE it afterwards to preserve this state. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ai_env_fallback.py is a reliable regression for the env-key fallback and the DOCX/PDF import paths (~2m 20s runtime, mostly import polling).
